toolchain: Qt CI (coin) template qtci-macos-15-arm-105, Apple LLVM 16.0.0 (clang-1600.0.26.3) per the QtCore build string; CMake via Qt configure; universal x86_64;arm64, thinned to arm64 in the app

configuration.qt_build_string: Qt 6.11.2 (arm64-little_endian-lp64 shared (dynamic) release build; by Apple LLVM 16.0.0 (clang-1600.0.26.3))

build_commands: for m in qtbase qtsvg qtimageformats qtmultimedia: tar xf <m>-everywhere-src-6.11.2.tar.xz

qtsvg, qtimageformats, qtmultimedia: <prefix>/bin/qt-configure-module . -- -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES="x86_64;arm64" -DFFMPEG_DIR=<ffmpeg n7.1.5 prefix> -DQT_DEPLOY_FFMPEG=TRUE && cmake --build . && cmake --install .
lipo -thin arm64 (the app ships arm64-only slices of the universal2 wheel binaries)
correspondence: Each shipped framework/plugin is built from the qtbase/qtsvg/qtimageformats/qtmultimedia v6.11.2 archives (module mapping in the evidence). The archives' .tag commits equal the v6.11.2 tags; PySide6 6.11.2 pins qt5 v6.11.2; QtCore reports Qt 6.11.2 built by Apple clang-1600.0.26.3; every shipped binary's arm64 __text equals the PySide6 6.11.2 wheel install. Configuration is Qt's published coin packaging config, not a per-build log.
